summary: Named as a McDuffie tower in Wilcox County in a Georgia list (2016); not the NHLR McDuffie Lookout in McDuffie County. No source found on its history or state.

evidence.supports: McDuffie tower in Wilcox County; elevation 381; coordinates 32.00173, -83.48039; codes BLL-64703 and gfc-521
The list was last revised in March 2016
The NHLR McDuffie Lookout is in McDuffie County, Georgia
The NHLR McDuffie Lookout is registered as US 1069, GA 18
A fire observation tower was erected on the Ware Hotel in Waycross
evidence.quote: tower was erected on the Ware Hotel in Waycross

evidence.supports: That tower perhaps followed from a 1928 forestry fair held in Waycross
evidence.quote: Perhaps as a direct consequence of a 1928 Forestry Fair held in Waycross

sources.title: History of the Georgia Forestry Commission

notes_for_editor: Identity is from the tnlandforms list alone (name 'mcduffie', Wilcox County, coordinates, BLL-64703 and gfc-521 tags). Do not merge with us-ga-mcduffie (NHLR US 1069, McDuffie County, 33.445348, -82.542365), which is a different tower. No source found on the Wilcox tower's build, design, owner or state. The BLL code's meaning is not stated by any source read here. Field check needed.
